headline_claims.claim: FSMA 恢复跨金属坍塌: K=40 +0.0379 (Holm 3.5e-6), K=80 +0.0685 (Holm 5.5e-14); 5/5 金属各自显著, 恢复 within-metal 上限的 75-96%

honesty_boundary.note: 主线以强指标为主; 弱指标不删、不外移, 而是逐条配变强工作流 (W1-W9)。
red_lines: R1 — 不能『留赢的删输的』。赢的 (Ir within-metal) 与输的 (DOI-split -0.0383) 都留、都变强 (W2)。
R2 — per-metal 全表必须给。Ru 低 K 近 0/负, Os 曾 NaN; 不得用 5 金属 mean 掩盖。
R3 — 统计口径只能用 paired one-sided t + bootstrap 双报 + Holm。5-seed bootstrap 单独用是反保守的。
R4 — FSMA 是 adaptation 结果 (support 标签来自 held-out 金属本身)。零样本 LOMO 列不得用 K-shot 数替换。

Premise correction 2: it measures no per-reaction yield. STUDY_METRICS is diversity_tanimoto / validity_rate / synthesizability_rate / metal_compliance_rate. The blocker asks for >=80% per-reaction yield over 192 CFM val clouds — that number cannot be produced by this module at any data quality.

The products DO contain Pt (20/20 in the metal-seed probe). The metric is mis-specified for this harness — it measures coordination geometry, not metal presence.

MEASURED_silent_deaths: Wf-R16-A NCI-60 multi-day sequential (pre-flight gap compound)
metric.evidence: log frozen mid-stream + no traceback + no exit code + ps/nvidia-smi both clean (Phase 4a/4b diagnoses)

target.value: All scripts/launch_*.sh use setsid + nohup + stdout/stderr redirect to logs/
target.PROJECTED: 100% reliable background GPU launches; no silent deaths

root_cause: Bash tool run_in_background returns task_id but the spawned process group may be killed when the parent shell exits
Wrapper scripts have set -e but no nohup/setsid/disown; trainer process is killed by SIGTERM when parent dies
scripts/gpu_pipeline_master.sh is the canonical wrapper (already has nohup-equivalent via subshell) only the ad-hoc launch_wf_fix3lines_*.sh are affected
fix_steps: Step 1: Patch all scripts/launch_*.sh: prepend setsid nohup + redirect stdout/stderr to logs/<script>.log
Step 2: Audit: grep -L nohup setsid scripts/launch_*.sh (lists affected files)
Step 3: section 5.9 single-venv rule verify all patched launchers still use .venv/bin/python
Step 4: section 5.5 verification re-launch bace 5-seed; confirm 5/5 seeds complete + metrics.json written + no silent death
Step 5: Cross-reference wf437a1_single_venv_audit.py + _wrapper_audit.py

blockers.title: Generation collapse NOT fixed — fm + LR isolation only DELAYED it (ep5 -> ep18, same endpoint)

comparison_baseline.note: the fm=false baseline ends at essentially the SAME 0.062, so the fm objective did not change the endpoint — it moved the onset from epoch ~5 to epoch ~18.

metric.confound_warning: That baseline ran BEFORE the LR-isolation fix (16:36 vs fix at 20:33), so it differs in TWO variables. A clean single-variable control (fm=false on the fixed trainer) is running as cfm_fm_control_2026_10_09 and is the only valid comparison; the pre-16:36 baseline is a historical reference only.

CLEAN_AB_2026_10_10.design: single variable (use_fm_objective), both arms on the LR-isolation-fixed trainer, 30 epochs, identical config otherwise

collapse_onset_epoch.note: same onset; fm=false then collapses to a HARD ZERO at ep21 and stays there for 10 epochs, fm=true bottoms at 0.0625

CLEAN_AB_2026_10_10.VERDICT: Pareto trade-off, cleanly measured. The flow-matching objective does NOT prevent the collapse — both arms collapse from the same epoch. It roughly DOUBLES residual generation capability (decode_ratio 0.583 vs 0.250; gen_validity 0.063 vs 0.000) at the cost of the bond head (0.670 vs 0.784, delta -0.113).
CLEAN_AB_2026_10_10.BOND F1 IS A NEW PROJECT RECORD: fm=false reached 0.7836 vs the previous best 0.481 (+63% relative). The gain is real and is the single largest metric movement today — but it was bought with total generation failure, so it is NOT a free win and must not be reported alone.

root_cause: The collapse is a multi-task trade-off, not a single missing lever. With the bond head unfrozen the bond CE term dominates the loss by magnitude and the optimiser wins at that objective while generation degrades.

MEASURED loss composition (42-step CPU probe of the exact config): bond_ce 1.82 -> 95% of the live loss; wasserstein 4.3-4.9%; entropy_term 0.76-0.85%; 0.05*cb_loss 0.35-0.41%; the other 8 of 12 registered terms are exact zeros.

LITERATURE (UniGEM, arXiv 2410.10516): training generation and prediction jointly 'significantly degrades the performance of both tasks'. Their fix is to activate the predictive head only in LATER diffusion stages, after structure has formed. Our bond head is active across the entire trajectory.

LITERATURE (Dey & Ning, J. Cheminformatics 2024): auxiliary-task gradients can be orders of magnitude larger than the target gradient and crowd the objective out. Our bond_ce/bond_ce ratio is the measured instance.

MEASURED 2026-10-10 (clean A/B): the flow-matching objective is a MITIGATION, not a cure. Collapse onset is identical (ep18) in both arms, so the absence of fm_term is not the cause — BLK-C12 (bond_ce at ~95% of the loss) is. FM buys about 2.3x residual decode capability and costs 0.113 bond F1.
fix_steps: Step 1: Wait for cfm_fm_control_2026_10_09 and read the single-variable fm delta before attributing anything.
Step 2: Implement UniGEM's late-stage activation — gate the bond head's contribution by diffusion timestep so it only shapes the late (structure-formed) part of the trajectory.
Step 3: If that is too invasive, the cheaper test is to train the bond head as a separate stage or with a much smaller weight, and check whether generation recovers.
Step 4: Turn on pcgrad_multi_task (the flag exists, default false) so conflicting gradients are projected rather than summed — PCGrad, arXiv:2001.06782.

Step 5: Re-measure the FULL 30-epoch curve. Do NOT read a mid-run checkpoint: this run read 0.5391 bond_f1 at epoch 15, which sits just before the collapse and would have supported exactly the wrong conclusion.
blockers.smoke_gate: §5.7 50-step CPU; assert the bond term's gradient actually reaches the shared backbone (grad norm > 0) and that decode_ratio > 0
blockers.honest_negative_fallback: If late-stage activation does not recover generation, the bond head and the generator are architecturally in conflict in this setup. Report as such rather than continuing to tune weights.

metric_confound_found_2026_10_10.finding: bond_f1 不能单独作为生成质量头条：F1 与生成崩塌**反向相关**。同协议同 epoch(29) 两臂（molmetal/reports/cfm_fm_{ab,control}_2026_10_09/per_epoch_metrics.csv）：
metric_confound_found_2026_10_10.mechanism: 两臂 recall 都 ~0.89-0.92 而 exact_match 皆 0 —— bond head 塌向'对每个候选对都预测有键'。全正基线在 pos_rate 0.2986 下 F1≈0.460。F1 高低实际由 precision 决定，而 precision 跟着生成能力走：生成一死 F1 就涨。fm=false 的训练器自己写下 'gen_validity is saturated at 0.000 over n=48 samples: it carries no gradient this run'。
metric_confound_found_2026_10_10.consequence: 论文生成侧能写的最强表述是 fm=true 的 0.6703 @ decode_ratio 0.5833，且必须承认 exact_match 仍为 0。任何单独引用 bond_f1 的写法都是误导。
metric_confound_found_2026_10_10.corrects_an_earlier_claim: 本条此前把 'bond_f1 0.7836' 记作'项目纪录'。它真实存在，但**是崩塌产物**，不是纪录。我一度又误判它为'无源伪造数'并作废 —— 该判定也错。两次错误均按 §5.2 留痕于 docs/00_MODEL_NARRATIVE.md §5b。
metric_confound_found_2026_10_10.recommendation: 把 bond_f1 的 gate 改为联合判据：bond_f1 单独高 **且** gen_validity > 0 **且** exact_match > 0，否则判为退化。这样任何后续 sweep 都不会再把崩塌读成进步。
metric_confound_found_2026_10_10.also_note: flow-matching 目标**不阻止**崩塌（两臂同在 ep18 起崩），它把残余生成能力约翻倍（decode_ratio 0.583 vs 0.250），代价是 bond head (Δ -0.113)。这是 Pareto 权衡，论文里不能写成'FM 解决了崩塌'。

literature_2026_10_10.closest_work: MacroGuide: Topological Guidance for Macrocycle Generation (arXiv:2602.14977)
literature_2026_10_10.relevance: 其连通性项 F^{H0}_death = Σ_j (ReLU(d_j^(0)(X) - ℓ*))² 正是 ReLU 门限 + 平方 —— 与本项目选定的 hinge 形式同构，独立佐证该设计
two_lessons_not_in_our_code: 梯度稀疏是真实问题：梯度只流过参与拓扑生死事件的少数点，作者用 masked gradient scheme（只对离分子质心更远的原子施加梯度）防止子结构被'拉链式'解开
其 H1 项用【非平方】ReLU，实测好于平方——本项目的 hinge 是平方的，这是一条已知的可能改进方向，但未经本项目实测，不应默认套用
literature_2026_10_10.our_form_differs: MacroGuide 的门限 ℓ* 是物理量（最大键长），本项目的 τ 是统计量（语料 stay_mean 上界）。两者都可辩护，本项目用自己的语料反解更贴合，但不能声称与文献同源
literature_2026_10_10.gap: 未检索到针对 2D 分子图『可微连通分量计数惩罚』的既有工作——文献要么走几何/拓扑代理（MacroGuide、NucleusDiff），要么用构造性保证（片段词表、自回归 SMILES）。本项目的 bond-adjacency 随机游走方案在文献中无对应物

literature_determination_2026_10_10.VERDICT: 干预点在解码路径，不在 loss。A/B 的 null 是设计正确、位置错误。
literature_determination_2026_10_10.our_85pct_is_in_family: 85.1% 多片段在领域内不算灾难。对照：MolCraftDiffusion naive->curriculum 在 GEOM 上 valid AND connected 由 2.4% -> >90%；YuelDesign 整体 validity 53.7% / connectivity 99.5%，且 validity 随重原子数下降（10 个重原子时 77.8%）。
literature_determination_2026_10_10.field_practice_is_post_processing: EDM/diffusion 标准流水线：coords -> 键感知(EDM 距离表 / rdDetermineBonds / OpenBabel) -> RWMol -> SanitizeMol -> filter。领域标准的 --all_frags 标志即『取最大连通分量』。
literature_determination_2026_10_10.MANDATORY_DISCLOSURE: 文献明确警告：取最大连通分量『inflates validity without improving quality — you discard atoms rather than reconnecting them』。DiffSBDD 改用直接丢弃未连通分子，是『更诚实但产量更低』的选择。若采用必须并列披露。
literature_determination_2026_10_10.OURS_IS_ABSENT: 查证：trainer 第 4087 行的 Chem.GetMolFrags 仅用于【测量】碎片比例作诊断；解码路径没有任何最大连通分量提取。--all_frags 这一步我们没有。
literature_determination_2026_10_10.emerging_direction_is_repair: Pro-GAT（bioRxiv 2026.02.22.707266）用图注意力后处理器预测有界的坐标修正以恢复连接；TopVAE/TopoBridge（arXiv 2606.13955）用 BFS 邻接精修。Pro-GAT 明确论证过采样修不好这个问题。
literature_determination_2026_10_10.comparability_caveat: validity 跨论文不可直接比较（NEAT arXiv 2512.05844：EDM 查表流水线缺芳香键处理且对键长敏感，RDKit 版本也会影响 rdDetermineBonds 输出，重新统一评估后排名会变）。我们走 SMILES 而非距离表，故该具体批评不适用，但结论仍成立。

blockers.title: The loss contains no generation objective at all — 8 of 12 terms are exact zeros

MEASURED.source: 42-step CPU probe of configs/cfm_blk_c5_repair_2026_10_09.yaml reading the trainer's own _LAST_LOSS_TERMS

root_cause: Whatever the bond head is doing, nothing in the loss is asking the model to GENERATE well. The sampler is steered entirely by the bond CE it was trained on.

The fragments the sampler actually emits (MEASURED, 609 rows from cfm_fm_ab_2026_10_09/generated_smiles.csv): 64.9% multi-fragment, 44.7% contain a 1-atom fragment, and only 63.4% are unique. The pre-16:36 baseline was 100% unique. Uniqueness DEGRADED during training.
The pathology is degenerate fragmentation into loose atoms, not the hypervalent garbage previously assumed: ZERO valence violations across the whole set (max explicit valence 6, no C>4).
generated_smiles.csv is append-gated on _decode_with_rdkit_strict, so it contains only parseable survivors — unparseable failures are structurally invisible there.
fix_steps: Step 1: Decide what the generation objective IS. Candidates: uniqueness/diversity, fragment-count penalty, valency-consistency on the decoded graph, or a reconstruction term.

Step 2: Note that a pure RDKit valency penalty would repeat the BLK-C5 mistake — it is non-differentiable. It must be a differentiable proxy over the graph the sampler emits, or applied at sampling time.
Step 3: Track uniqueness as a first-class metric. It is the one that moved the wrong way and it is not currently reported.
blockers.honest_negative_fallback: If no differentiable generation objective exists that helps, report the architecture honestly: this trainer is a bond predictor with a sampler attached.

blockers.title: bond_head_warmup_epochs freezes the loss, not just the head — no generation objective exists during warmup

MEASURED.source: 42-step CPU probe reading requires_grad per loss term

root_cause: The intent was 'freeze the bond head, learn generation first'. What actually happens is that freezing the head removes the grad path from bond_ce (all_logits has no grad_fn), so during epochs 0-4 the ONLY term training anything is the Wasserstein anchor.
There is no generation objective in the loss to point the frozen phase at, so the phase is not 'learn generation first' — it is 'learn nothing but a geometry regulariser'.
This also means the LR-isolation and warmup levers cannot be evaluated during epochs 0-4 at all.
fix_steps: Step 1: Either give the warmup phase a real generation objective (see BLK-C12) or drop bond_head_warmup_epochs and stop paying for 5 epochs that train one term.
Step 2: Add a test asserting that every term intended to train has requires_grad=True in the epoch it is supposed to be active.
blockers.smoke_gate: §5.7 50-step CPU with a requires_grad assertion per term
blockers.honest_negative_fallback: n/a — this is a mechanism defect, not a metric gap.

metric.status: DOWNGRADED — the within-metal PRIMARY is NOT safe to claim. It is a random-split artifact, not a real advantage over the literature.
metric.PRIMARY: WITHIN-METAL ROC-AUC — Ru 0.8363 / Ir 0.8295 (5-fold CV on deduplicated MetalCytoToxDB). Both EXCEED the published field values (Krasnov 2026: Ru 0.81, Ir 0.73). This is the paper's positive result and it is locked.
metric.SECONDARY_THE_FINDING: CROSS-METAL TRANSFER PENALTY —— 数值同样被高估，因为 within 一侧用的是随机切分。用同一产物里的 DOI-grouped 金属内值减去跨金属值：Ru 0.6350-0.6179 = 0.017；Ir 0.6065-0.5276 = 0.079。远小于原记录的 0.2184 / 0.3019。此为两个分别测得的数相减，非单次运行，标 DERIVED / 需单次复跑确认。
metric.why_this_is_better_than_the_original_pro: 原方案是 '我们能跨金属泛化' —— 一个需要打败别人的主张。现方案是 '跨金属泛化的代价被量化了' —— 不需要赢，只需要把一个没人算过的损失算清楚。二区可讲，且诚实。

REFRAME_2026_10_10.my_wrong_framing: 我把 BLK-C15 的 metric 定成 'PRIMARY = 金属内 AUC / SECONDARY = 跨金属转移罚'，并把整个置顶文档的主线押在跨金属这条线上。
REFRAME_2026_10_10.why_wrong: registry/protocols.yaml 对 m19_lomo 记 baseline_paper: null / NOT ALIGN —— 跨金属是项目里**唯一没有同协议外部基线**的轴。把没有对照的数字当头条，等于放弃所有有对照的优势。
REFRAME_2026_10_10.the_actually_strong_axes: 同协议口径（docs/ALIGNED_COMPARISON.md，2026-10-08）：MoleculeNet 均值 0.8149 过 0.80 gate；m15 docking RMSD 0.6578 Å、5/5 pockets <=2.0 Å（DiffDock 通过率 38.2%）；m14 decode_ratio 0.9647-0.998（文献 ~0.5）；m21 NCI-60 9-cell 0.8007 ± 0.0160 ≈ Krasnov 0.81；Krasnov 对齐 chemprop 3 金属 0.7812；m13 RDKit validity 1.000；n_distinct 20（6.7x gate）。competitive/winning 9 项 vs behind 5 项。
REFRAME_2026_10_10.correct_placement: 跨金属这条线降为 §4 的**次要发现**（量化迁移代价），带 per-metal 表 + Rh/Os/Re 不可分辨声明。金属内 Ru 0.8363 / Ir 0.8295 超 Krasnov 可作为活性小节的一个正面数据，但不是全项目头条。
REFRAME_2026_10_10.still_true_and_kept: 去重口径下的数字本身没问题：金属内 0.8363/0.8295、pooled 跨金属 0.5996、标签噪声 ~7.6% 翻转率给 Bayes 上限 ~92%。这些是真实测量，只是**权重被放错了**。

PRIMARY_WITHDRAWN_2026_10_10.why_withdrawn: 同样的数据、同样的特征、同样的模型，只改切分规则：random stratified 5-fold 给 Ru 0.8363 / Ir 0.8295；DOI-grouped 5-fold 给 Ru 0.6350 / Ir 0.6065。两个金属都掉 0.20-0.22，且都远低于已发表值。随机切分让同一 DOI 的同批次测定跨训练/测试边界。

answer_2026_10_10.question: 『定义生成目标函数到底是什么』
answer_2026_10_10.answer: 它已经被定义、已经实现、已经通过梯度验证 —— 就是 Wf-R41 的 soft-valence 项 (valence_log_barrier, decoder_rework.py:417-499)。它是可微的 squared-hinge，作用在模型自己的逐原子逐边键级 softmax 上，与 C5 那个 numpy 不可微的 SA penalty 完全不同类。Phase 1 研究当时已经证伪了符号写反的假说，结论是『该项结构性不在 loss 里』；Phase 2 也已经给出了设计 (d) 并落地为代码。缺的只是把它放进 yaml，以及修掉它的量纲缺陷。
what_actually_remains: 一行代码：soft_valence 除以 batch 内 cloud 数，使其对 batch_size 与 cohort 不敏感
权重由实测反解（初始时占 bond_ce 约 10%），不猜
bond_head_warmup_epochs 先置 0，否则该项在 warmup 期梯度死（见 BLK-C13）
单变量 GPU A/B 判定，指标用 chemistry_validity_pass_rate（当前 0.000，是唯一能从 0 起跳的可判定读数）

UniGEM_attribution_CORRECTED.todo_json_said: BLK-C15 note:『先读 arXiv:2410.10516 (UniGEM) 的 late-stage bond-head activation，它是本条的直接先例』；BLK-C11 Step 2 也据此写『Implement UniGEM's late-stage activation — gate the bond head's contribution by diffusion timestep』
UniGEM_attribution_CORRECTED.MEASURED: UniGEM（ICLR 2025, 清华）论文里没有 bond head。两阶段调度激活的是【原子类型预测】与【性质预测】头（nucleation t>t_n 只做坐标去噪，growth t<=t_n 才加预测损失），依据是 InfoMax：I(x0;xt) 随噪声增大单调下降，早预测会注入噪声。成键预测 bond_pred 是官方仓库的可选代码功能，默认 False，论文正文只用原子间距离做后处理判键型。
UniGEM_attribution_CORRECTED.consequence: 若照原描述实现并引用，会把一个不存在的方法名写进论文。原理（结构依赖的头只在结构成形后起作用）仍可迁移，但出处必须改写，且机制解释是表示噪声而非价键合法性。

answer_2026_10_10.revised_answer: 生成目标是否『已定义』这个问题已被撤回式地回答了一半：soft-valence 确实是唯一已实现且可微的分子级项，但它的 cap 表与本项目语料矛盾（见 BLK-M1），所以『它就是正确的生成目标』这个结论不成立。需要先定 cap，再谈目标。

blockers.note_2026_10_10: UniGEM 归属已更正（论文无 bond head）。soft-valence 的 cap 表已按实测重建（BLK-M1 DONE）。但 soft-valence 针对的价键问题已证伪，assemble 一路 A/B 为 null —— 生成侧仍无一个已验证能 engage 的目标式。

ON_arm_result_MEASURED_2026_10_10.scope_caveat_dont_overclaim: 本队列很小：3 targets × 3 seeds = 9 runs，organic 种子，max_depth 3，n_simulations 50。'无可测影响'是**在这个规模上**的结论，不是'D-MPNN 对搜索无用'的普适结论。要下后者需要更大队列（n_targets 50 / n_seeds 10，即脚本默认值），成本按 9.1× 放大后不可忽略。

RETRAACTION_2026_10_10.my_wrong_claim: 我曾把本臂判定为 'HONEST_NEGATIVE：接线正确但对搜索质量无可测影响'。
RETRAACTION_2026_10_10.why_wrong: 队列规模：3 targets × 3 seeds = 9 runs，n_simulations 50，**max_depth: 3**（而 max_depth_reached_observed 已是 4）。叶节点价值要在搜索树上传播才影响最终解，深度 3 的树里它几乎无处传播。
RETRAACTION_2026_10_10.also_understated_the_channel: value += w_dmpnn_value * clip(pIC50/scale,0,1)，w=0.6、scale 下 pIC50~2.1，平均贡献约 0.157，上界 0.6 —— 相对其它 reward 通道本就是小量。一个 9 次运行、深度受限、增量较小的通道测不出差异，是预期内的，不是发现。
RETRAACTION_2026_10_10.correct_statement: **唯一成立的结论是：learned-value 通道已正确接入并可运行（n_dmpnn_eval 737、var 0.0951 非零）。** '无影响' 在本规模下不可判定 —— 既不能说有，也不能说没有。
RETRAACTION_2026_10_10.what_would_be_needed: 脚本默认规模 n_targets 50 / n_seeds 10、max_depth 提到 5-6，并把 w_dmpnn_value 扫一遍（如 0 / 0.6 / 2.0）。按实测 9.1× 成本放大，这是 GPU/CPU 预算决策，需用户定，不自行启动。

result_2026_10_12.verdict: COLLAPSE REPRODUCES FOR Ru/Ir/Rh; Re IS A SCORER-DEPENDENT EXCEPTION.  The official chemprop v2 D-MPNN lands at or just below the XGB probe and near chance on Ru/Ir/Rh, so the collapse is NOT an artefact of a weak backbone.  Os is near chance for both scorers (n=36, unresolvable).  Re is the exception: chemprop 0.7461 vs XGB 0.4429 (delta +0.303); Re's within-metal AUC is 0.948, so a graph representation transfers part of a signal the fingerprint probe loses.

followup_2026_10_12.verdict: The within-minus-cross penalty is POSITIVE on 4/5 metals (Ru/Ir/Rh/Re, +0.16 to +0.31) — the same sign and comparable magnitude as the XGB probe — so the collapse is not a scorer artefact.  Cross-metal chemprop is at/below chance on Ir (significantly below, p_below=0.038) and Rh (in null); modestly above chance but below XGB on Ru (0.5621 vs 0.6179, p_above=0.005); above XGB on Os (0.5559 vs 0.4950, in null, n=36) and strongly above on Re (0.7368 vs 0.4429, p_above=0.001).  Chemprop's WITHIN-metal AUC is below XGB's on all 5 metals (by 0.03-0.08), so the within column does not rescue the backbone.

blockers.hypothesis: ECFP4(Morgan r=2) 是固定、有界半径的子结构特征映射；L 层 MPNN 的表达力上界是 L-WL（Xu 2019；Morris 2019），所以 depth-3 D-MPNN 原则上比 ECFP4-r2 更有表达力，但在 n≈500-1250 的小样本下实现不出来。若该解释成立，两种表示互补，拼接后 GBDT 应能超过 ECFP4 单用。

blockers.confirmatory_arms: arm 2/3/4 为确证集；arm 5 是用户字面要求（嵌入->XGB），标注为上界；arm 6 是特征数负对照。
blockers.confound_warning: 监督 D-MPNN 在折内训练，其训练折嵌入是 in-sample；若直接喂 XGB，GBDT 会从嵌入里读出标签。两层 OOF stack 只修掉一阶泄漏，仍留二阶、差分性的折间渗漏（产生 z_i 的 encoder 通过权重见过测试折的标签），而它恰好放大我们要声称的那个小 delta —— 所以 arm 5 不能作为确证臂。
blockers.statistics: 每个 split seed 取 5 折均值 AUC（同折 -> 配对有效）；delta(m,s)=AUC_arm - AUC_ecfp4，5 个 per-seed delta；paired one-sided t-test(df=4) + t-based 95% CI；Wilcoxon + all_seeds_positive 作稳健性（报告不作 gate）；Holm 仅在 {Ru,Ir} 确证族上做，5 金属 Holm 作探索性敏感性表；判定「融合赢」需 mean delta>0 且 Holm p<0.05 且 t-CI 下界>0；bootstrap 仅作 *_reference_only（5 点 bootstrap 反保守，见 project_five_seed_bootstrap_anticonservative）。
falsification: 只有 arm 5（cross-fit）赢、arm 2/3 不赢 -> 是折间渗漏不是表示
arm 6（噪声）也赢 -> 是特征数效应不是嵌入
Os「赢」（其 D-MPNN AUC=0.42 低于随机）-> 泄漏红旗
跨 split seed 符号翻转 -> 不稳健
blockers.honest_negative_fallback: Feature fusion of ECFP4 with the D-MPNN pooled embedding did not improve within-metal activity classification over ECFP4-only XGBoost on the deduplicated MetalCytoToxDB cohort, on identical StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=split_seed) folds across seeds {42,43,44,49,123}. Per-metal deltas (fusion - ECFP4): Ru …, Ir … [95% CI …, Holm-adjusted one-sided p = …]. Rh/Os/Re are below MIN_UNIQUE_FOR_GATE=200 and reported as unresolvable, not gated. No pooled mean is reported. This is consistent with the D-MPNN being a strictly weaker scorer on every metal, so its embedding adds no information beyond the fingerprint; the activity-prediction backbone remains 'GBDT by protocol'. MEASURED.

监督嵌入不能直接喂 XGB（见 confound_warning）。

positioning_and_model_innovation_2026_10.serves: 贵金属抗癌药物设计 (precious-metal anticancer drug design)
positioning_and_model_innovation_2026_10.problem: 当目标金属(如 Os/Re)几乎没有该金属的活性数据时, 预测金属配合物的抗癌活性
positioning_and_model_innovation_2026_10.key_fact: SMILES_Ligands 不含金属中心 —— Ru 19135 行中含 '[Ru' 的为 0 行 (Ir/Rh/Os/Re 同样全 0)。输入只有配体+反离子。所以现有全部模型(含 chemprop v2)都是【金属盲】的: 金属只是被留出的标签。

differentiation.chemprop_v2: 金属盲的同分布 QSAR —— 单金属、同分布、一次性预测; metal_mode=none; 完全没有'金属位移'这个概念, 评测协议也不测它。
differentiation.our_line: 金属感知的跨金属适配 —— 把金属当成一等输入来建模, 目标是'未见金属 + K 个标签'。
differentiation.one_liner: chemprop v2 是'金属盲的同分布 QSAR'; 我们自研的是'金属感知的跨金属适配模型'。
differentiation.why_it_matters_for_drug_design: 贵金属药设的真实场景就是: 你在 Ru 上有一堆数据, 但要评估一个新的 Ir/Os 候选。金属盲模型在这里会塌缩 (transfer penalty 0.05-0.25)。

model_innovation.title: 金属中心作为图的一等对象
model_innovation.desc: 把金属原子作为节点加进分子图(而不是当成标签), 用 Oxidation_state / Charge_complex / Valence_e / Atomic_number / 配位数 / 配位几何。这是 chemprop v2 明确不做、而我们数据天然支持的事。
model_innovation.novelty: 把'金属身份'从监督标签变成可学习的图结构

model_innovation.title: 可跨金属泛化的金属描述符
model_innovation.desc: 周期表位置 + 配体场分裂 Δ + 氧化还原电位 + HSAB 硬度 —— 使未见金属可插值。PA15 的 desc 臂只用了周期表常量(无配体场/氧化还原), 所以这条路其实还没被公平测过。
model_innovation.novelty: 为金属维度设计的归纳偏置(inductive bias), 而非通用原子特征

model_innovation.title: 金属感知的消息传递
model_innovation.desc: 金属信息必须进 message passing 内部, 不是加到 head 上。PA15 教训: 加 head (token/desc/FiLM) 无效, token 甚至显著更差(-0.0488)。
model_innovation.novelty: metal-aware message passing, 区别于 chemprop 的 metal_mode=none

model_innovation.title: 适配友好的结构
model_innovation.desc: 为 FSMA 少样本适配而设计: 在金属感知层挂低秩 adapter, 使 K 个标签能有效移动'金属条件', 而不是只动最后的 head。
model_innovation.novelty: 模型结构与适配协议协同设计 —— 这正是 WM1 低 K 失效的结构性修法

chemprop_port_2026_10_14.serves: 贵金属抗癌药物设计 (precious-metal anticancer drug design)
chemprop_port_2026_10_14.headline: 之前我们在 chemprop 上做的所有改造(手脚)必须搬到自研主线上, 否则等于白做。核心事实: 论文方法(FSMA)本来就是在 chemprop 上原型的 —— 搬到自研 D-MPNN 不是新科学, 是【同一套协议 + 同一批杠杆换到我们自己的骨干上】。这正是让自研模型'比得过'的关键: 我们保留自己开发的全部杠杆。

key_finding.claim: PA15 的 metal_mode harness (none/token/desc/film) 【四个模式全部作用在池化读出层】: h = encoder.agg(h_v, batch) 之后才做 concat(token/desc) 或 FiLM(h=(1+gamma)*h+beta)。连 FiLM 也只调制【读出】, 从不进消息传递。
key_finding.implication: 这精确解释了为什么整条 harness 失败 (token −0.0488 显著更差): 它是一套完整的'金属加在读出层'装置, 从未触及 message passing。它必须原样搬到自研主线作为【负对照基线】, 而 I3 补的正是缺失的'金属进消息传递'臂 —— 两者同骨干、同协议, 差异只剩金属注入位置。这是干净的单变量对照。
key_finding.why_port_not_rewrite: 同一 harness 换到自研骨干上, 负结果才有可比性; 否则'chemprop 上失败 / 自研上成功'会被质疑是骨干差异而非注入位置差异。

hygiene_rules: H1 环境: 只用 `.venv/bin/python`。不搜索、不切换、不新建 venv。若 import 失败, 先确认是不是用了裸 python, 再查依赖, 不要换环境。
H2 数据: 只从本块 dataset_inventory 的两个目录取路径; 显式设 MOLMETAL_DATA_DIR=$PWD/.data/molmetal。禁止 `find /` 找数据; 禁止假设 /mnt/storage 可用。
H3 工作目录: 所有命令从 repo root (/home/hugo/codes/mol-metal) 发起; 脚本用绝对路径或 PROJECT_ROOT 锚定, 不依赖 CWD。
H4 产出: 每个 MEASURED 值必须引用盘上 JSON/report 路径 (见 rules[0]); 脚本落在 molmetal/scripts/, artifact 落 metrics/by_metric/。
H5 复用优先: 动手前先查 reuse_deep_dive_2026_10_14 —— 若已有模块能满足, 优先接线而非新写; 新写文件必须在 plan 里写明为何不能复用已有资产。
H6 泄漏: 任何用金属信息的步骤都要走 LOMO 泄漏规则 (训练集丢弃在留出金属里出现的配体); 金属条件化不得把留出金属的标签泄进输入。
H7 预算匹配: 任何对照/消融臂 (尤其 I3 vs C2) 必须与主臂【同优化步数、同预算】; 否则 delta 不可归因 (见 project_ablation_budget_matching 教训: 400x 错配曾翻转 C2 结论)。
H8 统计: 多 seed 对照用 paired one-sided t-test, 不用 5-point bootstrap (后者 anti-conservative, 见 project_five_seed_bootstrap_anticonservative)。
H9 复现: 任何要写进论文的数字, 必须能从 producer_script + artifact 一键重跑; 改动脚本后同步更新 paper_a/repro/metric_manifest.json。

repositioning.from: Analysis / benchmark paper：Claim 1 坍塌 + Claim 2 预训练负 + Claim 3 赢/输各一 + Claim 4 方法，4 条主张里 3 条是 honest negative。
repositioning.to: Method paper：跨金属少样本适配（FSMA）。坍塌从『结论』降为『任务定义/动机』，方法是主线。

variants.FSMA-FT: 源金属多源预训练（ligand-disjoint LOMO）-> 冻结/解冻后在目标金属 K 个标记配体上微调 -> 在 disjoint query 上打分。
variants.FSMA-Meta: 跨金属 episode 元训练（Reptile 一阶，避免 MAML 二阶代价）-> 目标金属 K-shot 适配。二期/可选。

repositioning.why_this_is_the_fastest_route: K-shot 恢复曲线已经是 MEASURED 且家族校正显著（K=40 +0.0907，Holm p=0.0036；K=20 +0.0580，Holm p=0.0039），是全项目唯一‘正的 + 显著的 + 方法学的’资产。把它从『第 4 条附属主张』升为论文主线，只需补对照臂与消融，不需要新数据集、不需要新骨干。

honesty_boundary.note: 主线以强指标为主；弱指标不删、不外移，而是逐条配变强工作流（W1-W9）。任何正主张的对抗性测量必须始终存在。
red_lines: R1 — 不能『留赢的删输的』。若保留『我们赢 Krasnov within-metal（Ir +0.09~0.13）』，就必须同时保留 DOI-split 跨队列 −0.0383。**本计划的处置已更新为：两个都留、两个都变强** —— 赢的（Ir within-metal）继续作为 Tier-1 主张；输的（DOI-split）走 W2 变强工作流（同 23-cell-line 口径重算），变强后若仍为负，则写成跨队列口径差异的 limitations 段落，但绝不删除。
R2 — per-metal 全表必须给。Ru 在 K<=20 的 delta 接近 0 甚至为负（K=5 −0.0492、K=10 −0.0195、K=20 −0.0179），Os 在 K=40 是 NaN；不得用 5 金属 mean 掩盖。正文给 per-metal 表，Ru/Os 写作 measured-but-weak。
R3 — 统计口径只能用 paired one-sided t + bootstrap 双报 + Holm 家族校正。5-seed 百分位 bootstrap 单独用在 n=5 时是反保守的（Ir 一例：bootstrap p=0.012 vs t p=0.068），不得作为唯一依据。K-shot 的 n=50 单元 bootstrap 可用但仍须双报。
R4 — FSMA 是 adaptation 结果：support 标签来自 held-out 金属本身。零样本 LOMO 列仍是基准数，不得用 K-shot 数替换 Table 1 的跨金属列（沿用 l3_kshot_curve.json 的 honest_framing_note）。

C1_kshot_curve_paperfunnel.read: STRONG at K>=40 on the paper_funnel cohort. K=40 +0.0470 (Holm-sig, 39/50+); K=80 +0.0783 (Holm-sig, 50/50 cells positive, ALL 5 metals individually significant: Ru+0.035 Ir+0.061 Rh+0.091 Os+0.051 Re+0.154), recovering 75-96% of the within-metal ceiling. Only the low-K regime is negative (K=5 Holm-sig-neg, K=10 ns); C4 head-only targets it. Monotone increasing from K=20 onward.
C1_kshot_curve_paperfunnel.lever: RESOLVED — main curve is head-only; no significant negative anywhere.
C1_kshot_curve_paperfunnel.protocol: HEAD-ONLY adaptation is the MAIN curve (user OK 2026-10-13)

head_only_curve.verdict: ALL-POSITIVE and monotone from K=20. No significant negative at any K. K=40/80 Holm-sig.

fullscope_curve_reference.note: Kept as the C4 ablation reference; K=5 is Holm-sig NEGATIVE here, which is exactly why head-only is the main protocol.

W2_krasnov_23cell.read: Model class is NOT the confound (LightGBM 0.7677 ~= D-MPNN 0.7717 on the same cohort+folds). Matching the paper's cohort size (top-23 cell lines by row volume, the classic 23 cancer lines) makes LightGBM WORSE (0.7511). The residual gap is cohort-scope / unknown exact cell-line set, not model class. Diagnostic: random-split run in flight.

split_sensitivity_diagnostic.read: SAME cohort (top-23 lines), SAME model (Morgan+LightGBM), SAME label cut; ONLY the split scheme changes. Random 10-fold (DOI-leaky, same article in train+test) = ~0.92; DOI-grouped 10-fold (leak-controlled) = 0.7511. The paper's 0.810 sits between, i.e. it is only reachable under a NON-grouped split. So the W2 gap is a protocol-sensitivity artifact, not a model-capability gap: our leak-controlled number is the stricter one.
split_sensitivity_diagnostic.conclusion: W2 resolved as protocol-driven. Headline: report the DOI-grouped number; note the paper's 0.810 is exceeded under a random split.

W2_krasnov_23cell.resolution: PROTOCOL-DRIVEN. Same cohort/model/label; random split 0.9182 vs DOI-grouped 0.7511; paper 0.810 sits between -> only reachable under a non-grouped split. Our leak-controlled number is stricter. No model-capability gap.

C3_support_sampler_k20_fixed.read: With the sampler bug fixed the four arms are DISTINCT, but the ordering REVERSES the C3 hypothesis: random (+0.0135) >= stratified (+0.0054) >= scaffold_diverse (+0.0011) > activity_scaffold (-0.0184). Support-set construction is NOT a positive lever at K=20 (n=25, none Holm-sig). C3 cannot be a headline novelty claim as written.

C2_controls_budget_unmatched.confound: NOT budget-matched: the control arms called run_one(epochs=args.epochs=50) on the full source pool (~8150 optimizer steps) while the K-shot fine-tune performs only ft_epochs*ceil(K/batch)=20 steps. ~400x compute mismatch.
C2_controls_budget_unmatched.supported_claim: adaptation > from-scratch IS supported: kshot +0.0151/+0.0327 vs from_scratch -0.0404/-0.0112.
C2_controls_budget_unmatched.falsified_as_written: the 'beats concat_retrain' half of C2 is confounded and cannot be claimed until step-matched.

C2_matched_rerun.fix: run_one gained max_steps; each control is capped at the fine-tune's exact optimizer-step count (ft_steps recorded per cell).

k20.read: CONFOUND WAS THE ENTIRE EFFECT. Once every control is capped at the fine-tune's exact 20 optimizer steps, concat_retrain collapses from +0.0507 (unmatched) to -0.1619, and from_scratch from -0.0404 to -0.0948, while k-shot adaptation holds at +0.0171 (p1=0.0395). So the C2 claim is now fully supported: the lift is the ADAPTATION, not the extra labels or the extra compute. The unmatched concat_retrain>kshot ordering was ~400x step mismatch.

k40.read: Same verdict as K=20, stronger: step-matched k-shot adaptation +0.0424 (Holm-sig, p1=3.9e-6, 38/50) while both controls are strongly negative. The unmatched concat_retrain>kshot ordering is fully explained by the ~400x optimizer-step mismatch.

C2_matched_rerun.verdict: C2 SUPPORTED, CLEAN. At matched optimizer steps the ordering is kshot (+0.0171/+0.0424) >> from_scratch (-0.0948/-0.0763) >> concat_retrain (-0.1619/-0.1619) at K=20/40. The lift is the ADAPTATION operator, not the extra labels and not the extra compute.

C4_adapt_scope_ablation.read: Freezing the encoder and fine-tuning only the head REMOVES the low-K significant negative: K=5 full -0.0171 (Holm-sig-neg) -> head +0.0097 (p1=0.0249); K=10 full -0.0094 -> head +0.0015; K=20 full +0.0148 -> head +0.0084 (both ns). At K=40 head is still Holm-sig (+0.0379, 40/50). head_metal@K=20 (+0.0120, 31/50) is intermediate. Reading: at low K, updating the whole encoder overfits the tiny support; a head-only adaptation is the robust default and is what C1 should report for K<=10.
C4_adapt_scope_ablation.implementation: --k-shot-adapt-scope {full,head,head_metal}; _set_adapt_scope freezes all params then re-enables head (+ metal_embed/metal_proj/film for head_metal). Regression test: test_c4_adapt_scope_freezes_the_encoder.

C5_xgb_warmstart.protocol: Morgan-FP(2048, r=2) + XGBoost; base_rounds=500, ft_rounds=50, control_rounds=550; 5 seeds x 5 metals.
C5_xgb_warmstart.read: CROSS-BACKBONE CONFIRMATION. The same FSMA LOMO K-shot protocol reproduces its curve on a completely different model class (gradient-boosted trees over fingerprints): warm-start adaptation rises monotonically +0.0029/+0.0197/+0.0435/+0.0786 for K=10/20/40/80 (K=80 p1=2e-7, 25/25 cells positive). The FSMA effect is therefore NOT an artifact of the D-MPNN encoder. from_scratch collapses at low K (-0.13 at K=5); concat_retrain is competitive here but never beats warm-start (K=80 0.0786 vs 0.0644).
C5_xgb_warmstart.note: Control arms are round-matched (control_rounds=550 = base 500 + ft 50), so the C2 confound does not apply.

Chem. 2026, 69(8) 8838-8851, DOI 10.1021/acs.jmedchem.5c02755) — a CLASSIFICATION paper (assign the cytotoxicity class within Ru/Ir subsets + external validation + multimetal prediction). T1_pic50_regression.protocol: paper-funnel per metal; DOI-grouped 10-fold CV (seed=0); morgan+rdkit+counterion features; LightGBM/XGBoost regressor; row-level pIC50

T1_pic50_regression.note: Krasnov reports no pIC50 MAE (classification paper) -> no head-to-head numeric on this axis; it is our own regression baseline.

T2_threshold_classification.metrics: accuracy / balanced_accuracy / sensitivity / specificity / precision / f1 / mcc / cohen_kappa / brier at a FIXED threshold (0.5)

T3_calibration_and_ranking.metrics: PR-AUC (average precision) per fold; ECE + reliability bins on pooled out-of-fold probs; applicability-domain coverage + in/out-of-AD AUC (Tanimoto-to-train, cut 0.4)

T4_external_temporal.protocol: prospective temporal holdout: train Year<=2021, test Year>2021 (DOI-constant Year, straddle asserted 0); random-split reference at the same test size gives the temporal gap
T4_external_temporal.note: Strongest external validation available offline; no second same-rule DB on host.

ex1_result_2026_10_14.protocol: paper_funnel LOMO + FSMA head-only K-shot; encoder frozen; identical query across arms; 5 metals x 3 arms x K=10 x 5 seeds = 25 paired runs; epochs=20, adapt-steps=30, lr=3e-4
reading: 预注册方向是 message > readout。zero_shot 下 message 【显著更差】 (0.6061 vs 0.6529, −0.0468, t=−4.50)。
K=10 head-only 适配后 message 与 readout 无显著差异 (+0.0030, p=0.37)。
结论: 【金属注入位置不是瓶颈】—— I3 (金属进消息传递) 并不优于 C2 (金属加读出层), 甚至 zero_shot 更差。
这与 PA15 完全自洽 (token −0.0488 显著更差): 金属条件化路线 (无论加 head 还是进 message) 都未恢复跨金属塌缩。
诚实负结果按 U2 的预注册出口处理: 有效科学, 不掩盖。
implication_for_plan: I3 的原假设 (金属进消息传递是关键) 未获支持 —— 需要重新定位创新点。
真正的问题可能是: (a) 金属描述符太弱 (仅周期表常量+OS+几何), 见 I2 未做; (b) 跨金属信号本身难以在 ligand-only 图上传递; (c) 需要 I1 的金属【节点】而非仅注入。
EX1 中三臂都用了 I1 的金属节点 (use_metal_node=True), 所以 I1 节点本身也未救回。
下一步应做 I2 (更强的金属描述符: 配体场Δ/氧化还原/HSAB), 并考虑 I4 adapter。
K=10 head-only 适配本身不稳 (多 seed 掉到 zero_shot 以下) —— 适配协议也需改进 (A1 deep-adaptation)。
ex1_result_2026_10_14.honest_note: message 臂在 zero_shot 显著更差可能部分来自 _MetalAwareGRU 的 3H 输入在冻结 encoder 下更难训练; 但这正是'金属进 message'的真实代价, 不是假象。

literature_2026_10_10.why: The 2026-10-09/10 CFM work measured a multi-task trade-off, not a missing knob. These are the papers that say what to do about that specifically. Nothing here has been read in full — they are leads selected from search, to be read before any of the above is implemented.

entries.paper: UniGEM: A Unified Approach to Generation and Property Prediction for Molecules
entries.why: Closest match to what we measured. Reports that joint generation + prediction training 'significantly degrades the performance of both tasks', and attributes it to the denoiser being active across the whole trajectory while properties are only meaningful once structure has formed. Fix: activate the predictive head only in later diffusion stages.

entries.paper: Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing
entries.why: CONDITIONAL MEMORISATION in graph diffusion coincides with a growing generalisation gap, and CANNOT be mitigated by early stopping. Memorisation onset always precedes structure emergence, so earlier checkpoints give structureless graphs. Directly relevant: our gen_validity peaks at epoch 7-13 then falls to 0.0625 — if this mechanism is ours, early stopping the run at its best gen_validity would be the wrong move, and we should NOT reach for it without reading this first.

entries.paper: Bigger Isn't Always Memorizing: Early Stopping Overparameterized Diffusion Models
entries.why: Generalisation is achieved BEFORE memorisation onset, and memorisation time scales linearly with dataset size. Demonstrated on D3PM, the discrete-diffusion family graph models use. Gives a quantitative handle on WHERE in an epoch curve quality should peak — relevant because our curve peaks at ep7-13 of 30.

entries.paper: PCGrad: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
entries.why: We ALREADY HAVE the flag: configs/cfm_blk_c5_repair sets pcgrad_multi_task: false. Projecting conflicting gradients is the standard remedy for exactly the bond-CE-dominates situation we measured, and it is currently switched off.

entries.paper: Enhancing molecular property prediction with auxiliary learning and task-specific adaptation
entries.why: Auxiliary-task gradients can be orders of magnitude larger than the target gradient and crowd the objective out. Our bond_ce/bond_ce ratio of ~95% is the measured instance.

entries.paper: MolDiff: Addressing the Atom-Bond Inconsistency Problem in 3D Molecule Diffusion Generation
entries.why: Joint atom-bond generation beats post-hoc bond inference; validity improves ~3x. Relevant to how our YuelBond bond head relates to the sampler.

entries.paper: Do Graph Diffusion Models Accurately Capture and Generate Substructure Distributions?
entries.why: GDM scores well on validity while showing TV distance ~1.0 on 7-node paths and 6-node cycles — i.e. VALIDITY IS A WEAK PROXY, exactly as decode_ratio=1.000 coexisting with 64.9% fragmentation showed for us. Also identifies the GNN backbone's subgraph-counting expressivity as a bottleneck.

entries.paper: How Far Can You Grow? Characterizing the Extrapolation Frontier of Graph Generative Models for Materials Science
entries.why: Local bond fidelity diverges wildly OOD (BondMAE up to 2.09x) while global geometry stays plausible — a warning that our plausible-looking molecules may hide local chemical damage.

entries.paper: Curriculum Sampling: A Two-Phase Curriculum for Efficient Training of Flow Matching
entries.why: Middle-biased timestep sampling accelerates early convergence but imposes an asymptotic quality ceiling; documents a U-shaped per-timestep loss profile. Evaluated on images, not molecules — treat as a lead, not evidence.

RC1_label_noise_MEASURED.finding: 标签矛盾率随测量次数上升：2 次 14.08%(58/412)、3 次 26.03%(95/365)、4 次 28.86%(71/246)、5 次 39.52%(49/124)、6 次 34.52%。若标签是配体的确定属性，测得越多应越一致；实测相反，说明每次测量携带独立噪声。
RC1_label_noise_MEASURED.inferred_flip_rate: 对称翻转模型从 n=2 的 0.1408 反推 p≈0.0762；代入 n=5 预测 0.2813，实测 0.3952 —— **模型低估**，故 p 仅作数量级估计。
RC1_label_noise_MEASURED.implication: 标签噪声使观测到的 within-metal AUC 相对底层化学衰减，其中一部分不可消除。⚠️ **撤回此前'Bayes 准确率上界约 92%'的表述**：1−p=0.924 只是单次测量正确的概率，不是可达 AUC 的上限；对称翻转模型下多数投票收敛到真标签，不存在这样的天花板。该衰减的**大小未量化**，论文不得引用任何由此导出的上限。

SECOND_REVISION_2026_10_10.headline: 本日两次自查推翻了本节早先的核心结论。最终状态如下。
survives: loss 项 liveness 实测：cfm.yaml 下 4/12 活、全 flag 下 12/12 活。工程完整，配置从未索要。
soft_valence 归一化缺陷与修复（跨 cohort 1626.7 倍 -> 同 cohort 1.28 倍）。独立成立。
m5 QED 0.1984/0.2008/0.1749 vs 目标 0.50 —— honest-negative。
G1 前提修正：tmQM 预训练编码器与 CFM bond head 是两套不同的 D-MPNN 实现，键名重叠 0，无法直接加载。
cfm.yaml 的 resume_from 默认 auto 会继承盘上 pre-EGNN 时代的旧 checkpoint 并直接终止运行 —— 已修（三份配置均显式写 none）。
withdrawn: 『0/2146 分子化学无效』——是失效的检查，不是生成器的性质。真值 0.8495。
『生成崩塌的根因是价键项从未被惩罚』——前提不存在，结论撤回。
『UniGEM 的 late-stage bond-head activation』——UniGEM 论文没有 bond head，该先例归属错误。
『m7 数值不可解释』——该caveat建立在 0/2146 之上，随之撤回，待重测。
SECOND_REVISION_2026_10_10.new_real_blocker: BLK-M1：loss 侧金属 cap 表（Pt=4/Ru=6/Ir=6，Rh/Os/Re 缺表）与 tmQM 实测配位（主体 cn6）矛盾。
SECOND_REVISION_2026_10_10.process_note: 本日流程错误：跳过了 todo.json 自己指定的『先读 UniGEM』，直接进入实现；并且在提出 A/B 之前没有先验证那个将要充当主判据的指标本身是否在运行。正确顺序是 查证 -> 联网调研 -> 设计与修改 -> 测试 -> 实验。

BLK_M1_closed.what: 金属 cap 表按正确基座重建，失效的价键检查修好，两者用同一张表并加 7 个非空转 gate
BLK_M1_closed.cost: 零 GPU、零实验，约 40 分钟
BLK_M1_closed.metric_unchanged: 0.8495 在两套 cap 基座下都成立，说明之前的宽松 cap 没有掩盖问题
BLK_M1_closed.next: Phase 2 第 3 步 —— 重定义 BLK-C11：金属配位不足（生成分子中位配位 4 vs tmQM 的 6）到底要不要作为生成侧目标

cfm_metric_inventory_2026_10_10.purpose: CFM 线上所有弱指标的总账，按『模型真的弱』与『口径有问题』分开。分开的理由：今天六次自我修正里有四次是把口径问题误当成模型缺陷，其中一次差点花 4 小时 GPU 去修一个不存在的问题。

m4_sa.severity: DOWNGRADED —— 先前『最差的一项、超出可用区间两倍』是拿有机分子的 SA 尺度比有机金属配合物
m4_sa.root_cause: 部分定位：尺度不可比（Ertl SA 在有机库上标定）+ 分子体积（corr +0.27~+0.48）。碎裂已被排除为驱动因素。
m4_sa.lead: 方向线索：SA 最低的 blk_c5_repair(6.66) 碎裂率 81.6%，另两个(7.37/7.45)碎裂率 44.7%/52.5%。SA 高与『生成了更大更复杂的结构』同向。但 n=147 的那个 run 与另两个不同批，证据强度有限。
m4_sa.reference_points: 顺铂（PubChem 带电式，临床在用）SA=7.467；苯 1.000；乙酰氨基酚 1.407。我们的 6.66-7.93 与顺铂同带。
m4_sa.RETRACTED: 我先前说『SA 低者碎裂率高』是错的——blk_c5_repair 碎片最少(3.52)且 SA 最低；fm_ab 碎片最多(10.04)但 SA 居中。那是比较不同批次的 n=147 run 造成的假象。
m4_sa.REMAINING_UNCERTAINTY: 6.66-7.93 里有多大比例是体积、多少是片段稀有度、多少是真化学差，未量化。39 重原子的有机分子应得 2-3 而非 7.9，说明除尺度外还有实成分。

generation_collapse.root_cause: 已定位为主因：选择判据 combined = gen_validity × bond_exact_type_rate 在 30 轮里恒为 0，是常数，early stopping 不可能触发；于是训满 30 轮并报末轮(0.0885)。
generation_collapse.reproducibility: control 臂 cfm_frag_control 30 轮稳定复现，非偶发
generation_collapse.assessment: CFM 线最实在的未解问题，但已排除两条根因后继续盲试的边际收益低
generation_collapse.REFRAMED: 不是『缺生成目标导致崩塌』。三个证据：(1) 唯一试过的目标项梯度 ~5e-09、从未 engage；(2) 崩塌形态是不稳定而非干净衰减——ep18 是 128 个样本全空的硬失败，decode_ratio 在 ep18→ep20 从 0.5365 反弹到 0.9896；(3) bond_f1 是唯一稳定改善的部分(0.4599→0.5049)，与所有生成侧指标脱钩。
generation_collapse.classification: 训练稳定性问题 + 模型选择问题，不是目标函数问题。loss 项不是它的自然工具。
generation_collapse.leverage_check: 通过，零 GPU：用现有 per-epoch CSV 即可算出每个候选判据会选中哪一轮。非退化判据 gen_validity×min(1,bond_f1/0.45)（排除 ep<5）选中 ep24，decode 0.9167 / gen_validity 0.4453，对比末轮 0.0885 / 0.0469。
generation_collapse.OPEN_WEAKNESS: 0.45 这个下限是拟合常数，是该提案的弱点，必须从 bond_f1 分布反解而非拍定。已记录，未实施。
generation_collapse.floor_derivation: NEGATIVE —— 判据无法从现有数据推导，未实施。F∈[0.20,0.60] 全选 ep24（clamp 从不饱和，判据退化为纯 gen_validity）；真正的自由参数是最小轮次守卫，在 3/4 处有断崖。
generation_collapse.floor_derivation_detail: 假设『epoch0 是均值复制退化』被证伪：ep0-3 的平均最近邻相似度仅 0.2060（分子彼此不雷同）。反而是训练后期趋同（0.2060→0.3630，+76%）。
generation_collapse.not_shipped_reason: 守卫取 3 还是 4 决定选出一个『未训练但有效』还是『训练过但半有效』的模型——这是判断不是推导，数据回答不了。按 LEVERAGE_GATE 第二问不实施；编一个下限来让它能上线正是该规则要防的事。
generation_collapse.bonus_signal: 模式崩塌确实存在，但只在多样性轴可见：最近邻相似度 +76%，而 IntDiv1 平坦在 0.89-0.91、decode_ratio/gen_validity 非单调。项目报的两个生成侧指标都看不见它。未加入 panel、未用于任何主张（n 小、单 run 单 seed）。

fragmentation.COMPARISON_CAVEAT: 0.504 与 0.851 不是同一组 run，不能直接比，『碎裂在恶化』无证据。旧三 run 内部方差就很大(44.7%/52.5%/81.6%)。
fragmentation.root_cause: 未定位；但干预点已确定为解码路径（loss 项作用在预测图，碎裂在解码输出）
fragmentation.field_context: 85% 在领域内不算灾难：MolCraftDiffusion naive→curriculum 在 GEOM 上 valid-AND-connected 由 2.4%→>90%；YuelDesign 整体 validity 53.7%

bond_f1_decoupled.evidence: fm_true 臂 bond_f1=0.6703；fm_false 臂 bond_f1=0.7836 而 gen_validity=0.0 —— bond_f1 更高的那臂生成完全失败
bond_f1_decoupled.root_cause: bond_f1 是逐边交叉熵，对『整分子是否成立』无感。这是指标粒度问题不是实现缺陷
bond_f1_decoupled.consequence: 论文必须四指标联合报告，单报 bond_f1 即误导（docs/00_MODEL_NARRATIVE.md §5）

m5_qed.measurement: 在 776 个已解码分子上直接算：整条 SMILES 0.1952 vs 只取最大连通分量 0.2718 —— 相对低估 39%
m5_qed.counter_intuitive: 单分子 QED 反而更低(0.1246)，因为它们是碰巧连通的小碎片，QED 惩罚小分子量
m5_qed.conclusion: 『取最大分量』也不是正确口径 —— 85% 的输出根本不是单个分子。这个数字目前不应直接进论文。
m5_qed.proposed_fix: 只对单片段分子报 QED，同时报单片段占比作为分母

FIXED_2026_10_10.SELF_CORRECTION: 我先前说『m5 被相对低估 39%』是从 cfm_frag_control 一个 run 外推到整个项目，错了。真实规律是污染随该 run 自身碎裂率缩放：单片段占比 >0.47 的 run 几乎不受影响(−0.2%/+0.1%)；占比 ~0.15 的 run 掉 34-36%。

FIXED_2026_10_10.REVERSES_MY_OWN_EARLIER_CAVEAT: 我先前写『0.916 在无效结构上算、不解释』。查证证明碎裂不是原因：整条 0.9159 / 只取单片段 0.9024 / 只取最大分量 0.9090，怎么切都在 0.90-0.93。那个警告是错的，已撤回。
FIXED_2026_10_10.why_it_is_still_not_a_strength: CFM 的 0.90-0.93 高于 MOSES 训练集基准 0.857。Vendi Score (arXiv:2210.02410) 指出 >0.88 通常意味着分布偏移而非真正新颖性，且 IntDiv 无法区分真实多样性与组合随机性。
FIXED_2026_10_10.INTERNAL_CONTRADICTION: 在我们自己的五个 run 里，IntDiv1 与化学质量【反相关】：blk_c5_repair 是唯一低于 0.88 的（0.8516，贴着训练集基准），同时它 validity 最好(0.9864)、SA 最好(6.663)；最碎的 run IntDiv 最高。IntDiv 奖励组合随机性这个失效模式，在我们自己的数据里复现了。
FIXED_2026_10_10.conclusion: m7 对 CFM 线既不能当优点也不能当缺点用；它是崩塌报警器，不是质量分。
FIXED_2026_10_10.lambda_path_note: 同一文献指出 GA/搜索方法在 JNK3/sEH 上塌到 0.13-0.15 —— Lambda MCTS 的 0.1366 正是这个形态，那条路径上的低值才是诊断信号。

fusion_plan_2026_10_13.goal: 把 BLK-P1 的 honest negative 升级为方法学贡献：证明 D-MPNN 图表示与 ECFP4 互补，拼接后超过 ECFP4 单用；并给出可证伪的理论锚（WL 表达力 + ambiguity 分解）。

theory.wl_expressivity: ECFP4(Morgan r=2) 是有界半径子结构特征映射；L 层 MPNN 表达力上界为 L-WL（Xu et al. 2019 'How Powerful are GNNs'; Morris et al. 2019）。depth-3 D-MPNN 原则上强于 ECFP4-r2，但小样本下实现不出来 —— 这正是互补性的来源。
theory.ambiguity_decomposition: Krogh & Vedelsby 1995: E_ens = E_avg - A（ambiguity=成员分歧）。融合增益恰等于分歧项，可直接从 dumped 概率测量，给可证伪预测。
theory.bias_variance_covariance: Ueda & Nakano 1996: E = bias^2 + var/M + (1-1/M)covar。协方差小（成员多样）融合才有用。
theory.multiple_kernel_view: [固定核特征(ECFP) ⊕ 学习特征(D-MPNN)] = 多核模型；GBDT 在并集上做贪心特征选择。
